purpose: Distribute equal amounts or describe change in small steps.
keywords: Please hand out two sheets to each person.
I read a little each day.
I carried the boxes one at a time.
restrictions: Each unit receives the stated amount, or the amount advances step by step.
mistake: 三個ずつ means three each; it does not mean three altogether.
